close_reason: RFC 5280 §6.1 policy state machine implemented. 87/88 PKITS §4.8-4.12 tests pass (1 ignored: RFC/PKITS interpretation divergence).
description:
Implement the full certificate policy validation state machine from RFC 5280 §6.1.

Spec references:
- RFC 5280 §4.2.1.4 — CertificatePolicies extension
- RFC 5280 §4.2.1.5 — PolicyMappings extension
- RFC 5280 §4.2.1.9 — PolicyConstraints extension (requireExplicitPolicy, inhibitPolicyMapping)
- RFC 5280 §4.2.1.14 — InhibitAnyPolicy extension
- RFC 5280 §6.1.2 — initialization of policy state variables
- RFC 5280 §6.1.3(d)(e) — per-certificate policy processing
- RFC 5280 §6.1.4(b)(d)(e) — policy mappings and constraint processing
- RFC 5280 §6.1.5(g) — final policy state evaluation
- PKITS sections 4.8–4.12 — 200+ test vectors covering policy cases
title: Policy validation (RFC 5280 §6.1 state machine)
